root = body([
  heading("Tasks & Projects"),
  
  segmented_control(
    options=[
      {label: "All", value: "all"},
      {label: "In Progress", value: "in_progress"},
      {label: "Completed", value: "completed"},
      {label: "Pending", value: "pending"}
    ],
    selected_value=$/filter_status,
    name="status_filter"
  ),
  
  entity_list(
    items=_filteredItems()
  )
])

_filteredItems = () => {
  let filtered = $/items
  if ($/filter_status !== "all") {
    filtered = $/items.filter(item => item.status === $/filter_status)
  }
  return filtered.map(item => ({
    name: item.title,
    subtitle: item.detail,
    status: _statusBadge(item.status),
    meta: item.status
  }))
}

_statusBadge = (status) => {
  if (status === "completed") return lozenge("Completed", appearance="success")
  if (status === "in_progress") return lozenge("In Progress", appearance="inprogress")
  if (status === "pending") return lozenge("Pending", appearance="default")
  return lozenge(status)
}
